eyebrow: Key Lookup, the tax of a non-covering index
code:
-- index has ProductID, but not UnitPrice
SELECT ProductID, UnitPrice
FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail
WHERE ProductID = 776;

-- fix: add the missing column
CREATE INDEX IX_Detail_ProductID
  ON Sales.SalesOrderDetail(ProductID)
  INCLUDE (UnitPrice);
caption: One lookup per matching row — cheap alone, expensive at scale.

eyebrow: A predicate that quietly disables a seek
code:
-- Not seekable: function wraps the indexed column
WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2026

-- Seekable rewrite:
WHERE OrderDate >= '2026-01-01'
  AND OrderDate <  '2027-01-01';
caption: The "right" index can still exist and go unused.
